_comment: A baseline may only ever DECREASE: lower it the moment coverage improves, never raise it to make a red suite green. Per service it is the number of public api/ routes (uri starts with api/, not #[InternalMethod]) that carry an #[ApiMethod] operation and that no MCP tool covers, measured against {service}.contract.json by tests/coverage-gate.test.ts. 0 means full coverage.

linkedin._debt: None: full coverage. Was 13 until 2026-07-27, when the auto-scrape surface shipped its MCP tools and closed the last gap: mcp.linkedin/linkedin_auto_scrapes (10 routes: create, search, get, update, delete, pause, resume, run-now, set-mass-action, unset-mass-action), mcp.linkedin/linkedin_auto_scrape_runs (2: search, get) and mcp.linkedin/linkedin_auto_scrape_results (1: search). The 3 linkedin-posting routes (create-post, comment, react) used to sit here too and were covered earlier by mcp.linkedin/linkedin_posting.

orchestration._debt: None: full coverage. Was 9 until 2026-07-27, when mcp.orchestration/mass_actions shipped the 9 parent routes (search, get, create, delete, preview, metrics, pause, resume, release) and closed the last gap. Was 11 earlier the same day, before mcp.orchestration/mass_action_items covered the 2 child routes. Was 19 until 2026-07-26, when 8 (api/example-entity) were paid off the only way that surface ever could be - the service.empty ExampleEntity bundle was DELETED from gtm.service.orchestration, routes and table included.

id._debt: None: full coverage. Was 9 on 2026-11-12, from the moment the email-boxes surface (search, create, confirm-checkout, update, preview-resize, resize, delete, move-in, retry) landed with decision D12 of ADR 001 (several email servers per workspace) ahead of its tools, because the pipeline formalizes the MCP contract once the screen has settled it and buying a server needs the preview and confirm step designed first, until mcp.id/email_boxes covered all nine the same day (seven served on /mcp/id/billing, preview-resize and confirm-checkout REST only with surface api, which the coverage gate counts as covered). Before that: full coverage, was 5 until 2026-07-27, when mcp.id/account_shares shipped the whole account-shares group (search, list-received, create, recall, return) and closed the last gap; the two mass-action routes (recall, return) came off fixtures/contract-oracle/mass-action-allowlist.json in the same change, because a waiver that outlives the tool it was waiting for hides the next drift instead of recording debt. The 4 account-transfers routes were never counted and still are not: they carry no #[ApiMethod], so they are not an MCP surface at all.

email._debt: None: full coverage since 2026-11-13, when @gtm/mcp-email was authored: one definition per public route, 65 in 15 packages, 61 served on the four /mcp/email mounts and 4 REST only (surface api, which the coverage gate counts as covered): create and bulk-create-imap of email-accounts and create of email-oauth-apps carry a secret, and bulk-action of email-accounts is six verbs over up to 500 mailboxes. Was 65 on 2026-11-12, the whole public surface of gtm.service.email with no package at all: 44 on 2026-07-27, when the service joined the registry-keyed gates with an empty package set so that its debt was counted instead of invisible, then the five email-oauth-apps routes (September 2026), the two check-sent routes (October 2026), search-provider, bulk-create, archive, bulk-update and get-source (2026-10-31) and the nine routes of the Email Accounts screen (2026-11-12).
